prompt:
REDRAW this first Giger Machine sketch test as a MUCH SIMPLER AND CLUMSIER beginner drawing. This must be a substantial reduction of drawing skill and detail, not just the same polished train with more scribbles.
Keep WHITE background, thin hesitant BLACK outlines, light RED rough construction circles and a few BLUE/VIOLET exploratory strokes. No color fills or shading. A sparse loose unfinished sketch like a novice fan trying to draw their game locomotive.
Preserve recognizable Giger Machine identity: the locomotive itself is a monster, not a humanoid; a long simple rear boiler cylinder, huge oval brain dome above its front with ONLY THREE crude curved ridge lines, TWO long thin horn/brow spikes, ONE small side eye, blunt rectangular snout, a wide rectangular toothy mouth with just SIX big uneven square teeth in each row, FOUR mismatched wonky circle wheels attached by one simple crooked rod, one short crooked chimney. No cab driver.
Make every shape visibly awkward: wheels unequal in size and not perfect circles, wheel spokes only a crude X or 3 sticks, boxy body slightly lopsided, snout asymmetrical, mouth crooked, simple perspective a little wrong. Use only basic ellipses, boxes and lines. ERASE all tiny seams, mechanical panels, little hubs, rivets, accurate undercarriage, precision spokes, smoke details, dozens of rail sleepers. Remove professional volumetric construction and carefully shaded metal. Avoid cute polished chibi/vector icon styling.
Composition mostly side view with a slight wonky front angle, facing right, the locomotive biting/crushing ONE crude empty cube with no decorative bolts. Exactly THREE triangular fragments and TWO naive motion squiggles. Track is just two wavy blue lines and FIVE crooked sleepers beneath. Background almost blank white, only ONE wonky mushroom far left and ONE small floating-eye doodle upper right. NO detailed doorway or hills or environment.
Keep the red/blue construction strokes sparse and loose, a few un-erased guide lines on dome/wheels, not a perfect technical blueprint. Art must feel simple, amateur, underworked, uneven and spontaneous. Single landscape16:9 image, no text, panels or borders, lower fifth mostly blank white.
status: Simpler, clumsier style sample awaiting feedback; not imported into campaign.
